senses.d: Passionate ardor in the pursuit of anything; eagerness in favor of a person or cause; ardent and active interest; engagedness; enthusiasm; fervor.
q: I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
A zeal for liberty is sometimes an eagerness to subvert with little care what shall be established.

senses.d: Filled with, or characterized by, zeal; warmly engaged, or ardent, in behalf of an object.
q: He may be zealous in the salvation of souls.
